Personal data law compliance (technical side)

You know where customer data lives and who can see it, it moves to Uzbekistan and is protected, and you are ready for an inspection. An MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 30 mln; the full version in 6–10 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Data map of your systems and vendors
  • Gap list against the localisation requirement
  • Consent texts reviewed together with your lawyer
  • Plan of priority fixes
What the full version adds
  • Personal data moved to servers in Uzbekistan
  • Access control and logs
  • Retention and deletion rules
  • Help registering databases in the state register
  • Staff guide
Please note

We do the technical work; legal opinions come from your lawyer or a partner law firm.

What we need from you

  • Access to servers and accounts
  • A description of the current system
  • A technical contact

Questions

What does “Personal data law compliance (technical side)” cost?
The MVP costs $2,500–6,000 (UZS 30–73 mln), the full version $7,000–16,000 (UZS 84–193 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Personal data law compliance (technical side)” take?
The MVP takes 2–4 weeks, the full version 6–10 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Access to servers and accounts, a description of the current system, a technical contact.
